what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Montenegro, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12186 Ukrainian refugees in Montenegro, 0.2% of all refugees from Ukraine.
The largest numbers of Ukrainian refugees live in Germany, Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every year.
Before that, it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2017 to 2022, with the DPR and the LPR.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2022 at 32346 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 64640, at the end of 2023, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2022 and 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Montenegro.
These are year-end totals for Montenegro only, reported to UNHCR.
